title: Turn muddy water clear 🏕️
caption:
A bottle, sand, stones and charcoal: muddy water in, clear water out 🏕️
Clear is not safe: boil it first.
Save this, you might need it one day 👇
first_comment: Would you drink it after boiling? 👇
sources: Layered sand/gravel/charcoal filters remove sediment and improve clarity but do not reliably remove germs (US CDC, 'Making Water Safe in an Emergency')
Boiling: bring water to a rolling boil for 1 minute (3 minutes above 6,500 ft) (US CDC; WHO)
